posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: Greetings! After many long and arduous labors, this website now has a new, fully integrated shopping cart and store! This means that you no longer need to create a Google account to buy something from us, and that we should hopefully be able to iron out the various minor bugs that periodically plagued the ordering system. If you've been holding off on buying something due to store difficulties or not wanting a Google account, hop over there now and check it out! And, if you notice any issues, send me an email right away - I'll make sure that Joel knows about it and can take a look.
